tasks.label: Ensure PostgreSQL
tasks.command: if ! docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then open -gj -a OrbStack; i=0; until docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; do i=$((i+1)); if [ $i -ge 30 ]; then echo 'Docker/OrbStack did not become ready'; exit 1; fi; sleep 1; done; fi; if ! docker inspect market-evidence-postgres >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Container market-evidence-postgres does not exist'; exit 1; fi; if [ "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' market-evidence-postgres)" != "true" ]; then docker start market-evidence-postgres >/dev/null; fi; i=0; until docker exec market-evidence-postgres pg_isready -U market_evidence -d market_evidence >/dev/null 2>&1; do i=$((i+1)); if [ $i -ge 30 ]; then echo 'PostgreSQL did not become ready'; exit 1; fi; sleep 1; done; echo 'PostgreSQL ready on localhost:55432'
